claims.text: POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have ARRIVED only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. The driver's own trace contains none: derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0, derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.fix_count is 0, and across all 91 driver fixes the closest approach to the pickup pin is 507.89 m. With no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes preceding the 12:35:40 cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

POL-NS-01 limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event in the trip record. EV-TRIP-00611 carries arrived_at: null and started_at: null; the trip was terminated by the rider at 12:35:40 with no arrival marker recorded at all. Limb (a) therefore fails on the face of the record, independently of the GPS test.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. The measured dwell is zero: derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0, the accumulated in-geofence time is 0.0 s and run_count is 0 — a shortfall of 300 seconds against the minimum for this zone class. POL-NS-06 makes the fee unchargeable on that shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated with cancellation_reason_code of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. EV-TRIP-00611 records cancellation_reason_code 'RIDER_CHANGED_MIND' and status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER — none of the three recognised codes. Limb (d) fails, and with it the last of the four conjunctive conditions POL-NS-01 requires before the fee can be charged.

POL-NS-03, the wrong-entrance route that could otherwise carry the charge, applies only where the trace shows the driver stationary for the required dwell at a point not more than 400 m from the pickup pin. The driver's nearest fix across the entire trace is 507.89 m from the pin (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), well beyond that 400 m ceiling, so the clause cannot be reached and the coordinate distance test alone governs. There is no venue_id on the pickup to corroborate any same-venue account, and none is asserted here.

The only route by which separate in-geofence intervals could be summed into a qualifying dwell is POL-NS-06(i), which requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road and the waiting window. EV-ADVIS-00611-01 is MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — so limb (i) is unavailable to the driver. No advisory can excuse the shortfall, and in any event the trace contains zero in-geofence intervals to accumulate.

POL-NS-07 pays the driver compensation only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full'. POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (a), (b), (c) and (d) on this record, so the precondition is absent and no compensation is payable; the SGD 3.20 figure in the fare model is not triggered. The whole SGD 4.00 charged at 12:36:00 belongs to the rider.

The driver's statement that he 'had gone offline for a break' and 'never accepted it knowingly' is contradicted by the platform record itself: EV-TRIP-00611 records accepted_at 12:20:40, and EV-GPS-00611 shows his device transmitting 91 fixes at a 10 s cadence continuously from 12:20:40 to 12:35:40, moving at between 19.5 and 34.3 km/h over a 2.86 km track. His account cannot displace the arrival and dwell tests that POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-01 apply to those coordinates.

Rider presence is not an element of the refund under POL-NS-06, but the trace confirms the rider did everything the platform asks of her: her track holds 81 fixes, all inside 14.52 m of the pickup pin and all at 0.0 km/h, giving rider_qualifying_fix_count 81. Nothing in this bundle supports any account of a rider who was not at the pickup point.

The empty chat log does not impair this dispute. EV-CHAT-00611 is COMPLETE with 0 messages and truncated: false, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 0, so no POL-NS-08(c) chat defect arises, and the refund under POL-NS-06 follows from the GPS dwell figures alone and requires no chat content.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged on this record: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so limb (c) and limb (d) are not met; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 — below the count of 4 — against 110 completed_trips_30d, a rate of 0.009 against a 0.08 threshold; and the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0, so limb (e) is not met. The case is cleanly decidable and should be ruled, not held.

POL-GEN-03 defines FULL_REFUND as the whole contested amount returned to the filing party. The rider filed this dispute, the contested amount is SGD 4.00, EV-FARE-00611 shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00 reconciles with the POL-NS-01 fee schedule (GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee of SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00). A full refund therefore returns the entire SGD 4.00 and nothing further is owed to the driver.

claims.text: The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in the ledger reconciles with the POL-NS-01 schedule and discloses no fare defect: the STANDARD zone-class fee is SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, and the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the two, which is SGD 4.00. There is nothing here for POL-NS-08(d) to bite on, and the rider cannot found a refund on the ground that the amount charged is not the amount the schedule prescribes.

The driver never placed an arrival marker on this trip: arrived_at is null and started_at is null in the trip record, and the trip was never started. POL-NS-05 therefore has no false arrival marker to correct, and the limb (ii) referral that would record a false-arrival event against the driver cannot attach to this trip. The driver should leave this dispute without that adverse entry on his record.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider in the chat log, and there is none: the export holds zero messages (message_count 0, an empty messages array, truncated false, first_message_at and last_message_at both null). Limb (a) fails outright. Limb (b) fails too — the driver placed an in-app call at 12:32:40 that the rider answered for 40 seconds, three minutes before the rider terminated the trip at 12:35:40, so the driver did not leave the rider unanswered. This clause does not apply to this trip.

POL-NS-07's anti-farming limb requires BOTH a count of 4 or more no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days AND a rate above 0.08 against completed trips. The driver's record shows 1 termination in 30 days against 110 completed trips, a rate of 0.009. Neither limb is met, so there is no fee-farming pattern, no case for withholding compensation, and no escalation trigger of the kind POL-NS-09(d) describes arising from the anti-farming check.

The rider's account — that the driver 'was three minutes away, then further, then just stopped somewhere' — is contradicted by the driver's own trace. Across 91 fixes the driver's minimum distance from the pickup pin was 507.9 m and his mean distance was 2256.0 m, at moving speeds of 19.5 to 34.3 km/h; his one stationary reading (0.0 km/h) sits more than half a kilometre from the pin, outside any arrival radius. The rider's picture of a driver who drew close to her and then abandoned her is not what the GPS shows, and her inference that he 'didn't want a short trip' is speculation rather than evidence.

The trip was ended by the rider, not by the driver: cancelled_by is RIDER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, and the rider's own track shows 81 fixes all within about 15 m of the pin — she was standing at the pickup point when she chose to cancel. The rider's pleaded case, that a driver refused a short trip, is not made out on this record, and under POL-GEN-03 the present state should stand with the charge exactly as it is.

I do not ask the tribunal to find an arrival the trace does not show. The driver's own trace puts his closest approach at 507.9 m from the pin, and I assert no completed POL-NS-01 arrival and no qualifying dwell. The driver's case rests on the points above — no false marker was placed, the rider's POL-NS-04 coordination route is closed, the fee reconciles with the schedule, the driver's record is clean, and the rider ended the trip herself — and not on a dwell he cannot prove.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee does not stand and is refunded in full to the rider.

A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions in POL-NS-01 hold, and none does. (a) EV-TRIP-00611 carries arrived_at: null and started_at: null — no 'arrived' event was ever recorded. (b) POL-NS-02 deems the driver arrived only where the GPS trace holds at least three consecutive fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; EV-GPS-00611 shows qualifying_fix_count 0, and the driver's closest approach across all 91 fixes is 507.89 m from the pin. (c) The measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a shortfall of 300 seconds — so POL-NS-06 independently makes the fee unchargeable. (d) The trip was terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, not one of the three no-show codes limb (d) recognises. Under POL-NS-02, with no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before the 12:35:40 termination, the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund.

POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the charge: that clause reaches only a driver stationary within 400 m of the pin, and the driver's nearest fix was 507.89 m away. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00611-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) means POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable in any event, and there were no in-geofence intervals to accumulate.

The Driver Advocate's request that the charge stand on the rider's own cancellation is rejected. POL-GEN-03's NO_ACTION leaves the present state standing only where the filing party's claim is not supported; here the record affirmatively shows the no-show fee was never earned, and POL-NS-02 puts the money back. The rider's narrative that the driver first drew close and then abandoned her is not borne out by the trace (mean distance 2,256.0 m, always moving at 19.5–34.3 km/h), but that does not matter, because the fee fails on the driver's own coordinates. The Driver Advocate in fact concedes no completed arrival and no qualifying dwell, so the two sides agree on the decisive facts.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', and it is not; the SGD 3.20 figure in the fare model is not triggered. The rider's POL-NS-04 route is closed (the chat log is empty and the driver placed an answered in-app call at 12:32:40), but the refund does not need it.

No escalation trigger fires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) against 110 completed trips, a rate of 0.009 against the 0.08 threshold; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0 and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; the deciding facts sit in artifacts at weight 1.0 with no POL-NS-08 clock-skew, trace, chat or fare defect; and no false arrival marker was ever placed, so no POL-NS-05(ii) referral is recorded.

The amount: SGD 4.00 is the cancellation-fee line in EV-FARE-00611 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and it reconciles with the schedule — the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee SGD 4.00. A full refund returns that entire SGD 4.00.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. To the driver: the fee cannot stand on this record and no compensation is payable.

This is a no-show cancellation charge under the NO_SHOW_CHARGE policy. POL-NS-01 permits such a fee only if all four of its conditions hold, and on this record none of them does. (a) The trip record contains no driver 'arrived' event — arrived_at is null and started_at is null. (b) The GPS trace never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius: across all 91 of his fixes the closest approach to the pickup pin is 507.89 m and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0. (c) The in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 300 seconds, with run_count 0. (d) The trip was terminated by the rider with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, not by the driver with any of the three recognised no-show codes. POL-NS-01 therefore fails, and two independent clauses then require the fee back: POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes before the 12:35:40 cancellation → full refund of the cancellation fee) and POL-NS-06 (dwell shorter than the minimum → the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages).

POL-NS-03 does not rescue the charge. That route needs the driver stationary for the required dwell within 400 m of the pin; his nearest fix is 507.89 m, outside the ceiling, and no venue_id corroboration is possible because the pickup carries none. Because POL-NS-01 fails at every limb, POL-NS-07's precondition ('where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full') is absent and no driver compensation is payable; the SGD 3.20 figure in the fare model is not triggered. In any event the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check would not have bitten: 1 no-show termination against 110 completed trips over 30 days is a rate of 0.009 against a 0.08 threshold.

The driver's account that he had gone offline and never accepted the booking knowingly is contradicted by the platform record: the booking was accepted at 12:20:40 and the device transmitted 91 fixes at a 10 s cadence continuously to 12:35:40, moving over a 2.86 km track at 19.5 to 34.3 km/h. Whatever the driver believed, the arrival and dwell tests are applied to those coordinates, and they fail. His related point that the rider terminated the trip herself while standing at the pin (81 fixes within about 14.5 m, all at 0.0 km/h) is correct as a fact but does not change the outcome: POL-GEN-03's NO_ACTION leaves the present state standing only where the filing party's claim is not supported, and here the rider's claim that the fee is not chargeable is supported by the driver's own trace. The rider's inference that the driver 'didn't want a short trip' is speculation, but the refund does not rest on it — it rests on the measured non-arrival and zero dwell.

No POL-NS-05 false-arrival referral attaches, because no arrival marker was placed at all (arrived_at null); there is no marker to be false. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00611-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes the POL-NS-06(i) route by which separate in-geofence intervals could be summed, but changes nothing: the trace contains no in-geofence interval to accumulate. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) — the trace has 100% coverage with no gaps and 91/81 fixes, the chat log is COMPLETE at 0 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 0, the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the schedule's GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), and there is no clock skew — so no escalation under POL-NS-09 arises. Confidence is set below the cap: the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown), so the cap is 1.0.

The whole SGD 4.00 charged at 12:36:00 returns to the rider; payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 are adjusted accordingly, and nothing is owed to the driver.

To the rider: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to you at 12:36:00 on 11 Sep 2026 (EV-FARE-00611, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded to you in full. To the driver: the fee does not stand and no compensation is payable to you.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show cancellation fee only if all four of its conditions hold, and on this record none of them does. (a) EV-TRIP-00611 records no 'arrived' event at all: arrived_at and started_at are both null. (b) The POL-NS-02 arrival test fails: across all 91 fixes in EV-GPS-00611 the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at Blk 236 Yishun Ring Rd was 507.89 m, against a STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m; derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 and derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.fix_count is 0. (c) The required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 s for a STANDARD pickup and the measured dwell is 0.0 s (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec), a shortfall of 300 s. (d) The trip was terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT). With limb (b) failing and no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes preceding the 12:35:40 cancellation, POL-NS-02 gives the rider a full refund; independently, POL-NS-06 makes the fee unchargeable on the dwell shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and Driver: this dispute is over the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00611. The charge does not stand, and the rider is refunded in full.

POL-NS-01 is the anchor clause and it is conjunctive: a no-show cancellation fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. On this record none does. (a) EV-TRIP-00611 carries arrived_at null and started_at null, so there is no driver 'arrived' event. (b) EV-GPS-00611 puts the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at 507.89 m across 91 fixes (mean 2,256.02 m, max 2,836.97 m), so there is no fix inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius: qualifying_fix_count is 0 and the longest qualifying run is 0.0 s. (c) The measured in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s against the 300 s POL-NS-01 minimum for a STANDARD pickup - a 300 s shortfall. (d) The trip was terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT.

POL-NS-02 therefore applies directly: with no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before the 12:35:40 cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the fee is refunded in full. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result on the dwell shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she messaged. POL-NS-06(i) cannot fuse separate intervals into a qualifying dwell here: EV-ADVIS-00611-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable, and in any event there are zero in-geofence intervals to accumulate. POL-NS-03, the wrong-entrance route, is not reached: it requires the driver stationary within the 400 m ceiling, and his nearest fix is 507.89 m; registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill of POL-NS-03(ii) does not arise.

Driver compensation: POL-NS-07 pays the driver only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full'. It is not, so no compensation is payable and the SGD 3.20 figure in the fare model is not triggered. Nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces this; the fee simply never became chargeable.

The Driver Advocate's points are answered. His submission that no false arrival marker was placed is correct and decisive for POL-NS-05: the clause engages only where an 'arrived' event exists, and arrived_at is null, so POL-NS-05(ii) records no false-arrival referral against the driver. His point that POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider is also correct - the chat export is empty (0 messages) and the driver's 12:32:40 in-app call was answered - but POL-NS-04 is not the basis of this refund, which follows from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 on the coordinates. His submission that the rider cancelled the trip herself and the charge should therefore stand is rejected: the amount charged is a no-show cancellation fee, and POL-NS-01 authorises it only on the four conditions above, every one of which fails independently of who pressed cancel. His own concession that the trace shows no completed arrival and no qualifying dwell is an admission against his interest and supports the refund. The rider's suggestion that the driver refused a short trip is not what the trace shows - he was moving at 19.5 to 34.3 km/h and never came within 500 m - but her motive is immaterial: the fee fails on the record either way.

Amounts, read off the brief: EV-FARE-00611 shows the cancellation-fee line at SGD 4.00, reconciling with the POL-NS-01 schedule (the GREATER of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, POL-NS-08(d) discloses no defect), with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The full SGD 4.00 is returned to the rider.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 termination in 30 days against 110 completed trips, rate 0.009 against the 0.08 threshold, and the count is below 4); and no artifact is impaired on the POL-NS-08(a)-(d) limbs (no clock skew, max_gap_sec 0.0 with 91 fixes, chat count matching, fee line reconciling). Confidence 0.95, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-00611, EV-TRIP-00611) and above the 0.70 floor. No referral is produced by any clause, and this is a money ruling, not an escalation.
